long_biography.plain_text:
Alkosser studied food chemistry at the University of California, Davis, adding viticulture and enology before beginning a research-and-development career with national consumer brands. After marrying David Alkosser, the couple pooled their resources to establish a real-estate company. The business grew from its 1980s beginnings into a multistate platform that owns, manages, acquires and develops apartment communities, especially student housing in California and Texas.

The winery grew from an unplanned property purchase. The Alkossers acquired a Coombsville vineyard in 2009, and Alice took charge of learning the grape business. Experimental lots from the following harvest became Shadybrook Estate's first release. She subsequently helped assemble five vineyard properties, acquire a dedicated winery and restore the historic Rapp Ranch, combining wine production with equestrian facilities and visitor experiences.
